parts: Random few-shot sampling kills your prompt cache.
I learned this debugging $40 of Anthropic spend that should have been $4.
If your few-shot examples rotate per call, every call is a cache miss.
Hand-curate 3-5 stable examples. Pin them. Cache them.
The 'random for diversity' instinct is wrong here — diversity comes from the user's article, not the prompt prefix.
Net effect on my voice editor pipeline: $1/mo instead of $10, zero quality regression.
If you're paying for cached prompts at all, this is the easiest 5x you'll find.
